title: Atossa wife of Pharnaces
summary: Raleigh names Atossa wife of Pharnaces in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Atossa, daughter of Cyrus the first of that name, married to Pharnaces King of Cappadocia, and mother of Artystona. She is not Queene Atossa, whose desire moued Darius to warre against the Greekes. The one-word title would fold onto atossa, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
